artboards.title: (f) Full layout at 1280, sidebars as strips

annotations.text:
deckbuilder_ux T1 — signed 2026-09-15.

Amended after page-2 feedback: Clear / Save / Save & play season now live in the band's right cluster (they left the depth chart). The muted next-action hint became the disabled Save's tooltip. Please re-confirm (a) and (b).

For sign-off.

(d) Depth chart: no validity row, no actions — both live in the band.

(e) Roster and (g) Plays are the same kind of sidebar: docked, or a 48px strip. The plays strip's three dots read slot state (ready / needs roles / empty).

(f) Full layout at 1280 with both sidebars as strips: five ~172px depth columns.

(h) Everything expanded at 1280: band open, both sidebars docked at their 280px minimum — the depth chart gets ~640px, five ~125px columns, starter cards ~175px tall. That is the honest worst case at this width; it is what tier rules have to protect. Say whether that is acceptable or whether opening one sidebar should collapse the other below 1440.
